title.zh: 将八打雁省巴万市镇拉格纳斯村更名为圣帕斯夸尔村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Lagnas in the Municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas, to San Pascual
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Lagnas in the Municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas, to San Pascual
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Lagnas tại Thị trấn Bauan, Tỉnh Batangas thành San Pascual
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Lagnas ในเทศบาล Bauan, จังหวัด Batangas เป็น San Pascual
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Lagnas di Kotamadya Bauan, Provinsi Batangas menjadi San Pascual
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Lagnas di Perbandaran Bauan, Wilayah Batangas menjadi San Pascual

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2149_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Lagnas in the Municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas, is changed to San Pascual.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 24, 1959.
